screen: For each earlier-data stage, deduplicate masks only on completed training calls. Score the first executable call per contract using a $20-or-prior-volume reference position, estimated fees and a 10% sale haircut; clip net returns to [-1,1]. Require twelve distinct training contracts; rank mean minus one standard error as a search heuristic, not a confidence bound. Keep sixteen distinct entry/exit candidates per attention group, at most two per training mask. Human confirmation is an explicit exception: every distinct training entry-mask/exit/delay combination with twelve contracts receives all portfolio policies, even with a negative clipped mean; neither the per-mask nor group shortlist cap applies. Other attention groups retain the ordinary screen.
selection: Ordinary selectors require ten trades/eight contracts, positive returns at 5% and 10% sale costs and the stated training drawdown ceiling; maximize 10%-cost return. Robust selectors additionally require fourteen trades, ten contracts and three active training days, positive 10%-cost return after removing two best training tokens, and positive return without the best training entry day. Cash is allowed.
execution: One position and one trade per contract. $1,000 account; at most 1% of the sixty-second economic volume known five seconds before the call. At least five earlier swaps, twice prior median gas/MEV fees. Delayed market entries and exits; unfilled exits written to zero. Actual reserves, impact and fees remain unknown.
scope: Retrospective daily selections on repeatedly examined dates. Fixed validation candidates are unchanged. Human mentions measure attention, not endorsement or independently sourced information.
